cases.name: invalid-number-range
cases.description: A range that is not a range

cases.name: invalid-first-zero
cases.description: first_zero that is neither true nor false

cases.name: invalid-length
cases.description: A length that is not a positive integer

cases.name: include-without-range
cases.description: include/exclude need a numeric range to work on

cases.name: distribution-with-range
cases.description: A distribution and a range contradict each other
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="number" value="1..9" distribution="normal" mean="5" sd="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-number-percent-entry-that-is-not-a-number
cases.description: Percent on a number splits the length groups, so every filled position has to be a number to split by.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="10..999" length="2,3" percent="abc,50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-percentages-that-do-not-add-up
cases.description: The same total the other percent lists are held to: what is left over would have to go somewhere unnamed.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="10..999" length="2,3" percent="30,50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-with-exclude
cases.description: exclude= makes the draw a pick from a set of whole numbers, so decimals described a draw that was no longer happening — the engine dropped it and emitted integers
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..10" decimals="2" exclude="5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-with-include
cases.description: The same set, reached the other way
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..10" decimals="2" include="99"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-zero-with-exclude
cases.description: decimals="0" asks for whole numbers, which is what a set already gives — nothing is lost, so nothing is said
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..10" decimals="0" exclude="5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-without-a-set
cases.description: A fractional draw over a plain range is untouched
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..10" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: exclude-without-decimals
cases.description: A set without decimals is untouched
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..10" exclude="5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: decimals-with-no-range-to-round
cases.description: Without value= the generator produces a digit STRING — an identifier — and decimals reached nothing: <gen type="number" length="4" decimals="2"/> emitted 4566, 5773, 5192.

cases.name: decimals-beside-a-width
cases.description: A fractional value has no integer width to pad to, so length= was the one discarded: <gen type="number" value="1..9" length="3" decimals="2"/> emitted 3.78, 2.89.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="number" value="1..9" length="3" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: first-zero-the-range-can-never-satisfy
cases.description: Every draw from 0..5 is one digit, so a three-wide rendering always pads. The generator redrew a hundred times per row and emitted the forbidden shape anyway: 005, 002, 003.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="number" value="0..5" length="3" first_zero="false"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: first-zero-a-wide-enough-range-satisfies
cases.description: The line the check must not cross: 1..999 can produce a three-digit value on its own, so whether a given row does is the draw's business, not the validator's.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="number" value="1..999" length="3" first_zero="false"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>
